cv.name: Thomas Mulder
cv.headline: Account Executive – Mid-Market SaaS | Benelux & DACH
cv.summary: Sales professional with eight years across inside sales, business development and account management in Amsterdam's SaaS and fintech scene. I took some sideways steps along the way, including a stint in customer success, and now close new mid-market business for an analytics company.

experience.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
bullets: Run the full sales cycle for mid-market retail and logistics prospects in Benelux and DACH
Closed €1.4M in new ARR in 2025, 112% of quota
Work with solutions engineers on demos and proofs of concept
Forecast pipeline in Salesforce and coach two SDRs on discovery calls

experience.title: Account Manager / Customer Success
bullets: Managed a book of 60 merchants and handled renewals and upsells
Moved from customer success into account management after one year

experience.title: Business Developer
bullets: Signed bike shops for a lease marketplace; the company paused expansion after ten months
